title: Pokemon TCG Flittle Surging Sparks 094/191 Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokémon TCG card featuring Flittle, part of the Sv08: Surging Sparks set. This English-language card has a common rarity, a high HP of 40 as a basic Pokémon card, and a unique Reverse Holo finish. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company, this collectible card game item is a valuable addition to any Pokémon TCG collection.
